bonus.correct: 15–17 hp jævn – kan rumme 5-farve i major
options: 15–17 hp jævn – kan rumme 5-farve i major
bonus.why: 1NT er 15–17 jævn, og alle jævne hænder åbnes 1NT – også med 5-farve i major. Derfor undersøger ASS hele majorfordelingen.

bonus.correct: 15–17 HCP balanced – may contain a five-card major
options: 15–17 HCP balanced – may contain a five-card major
15–17 HCP balanced – never a five-card major
bonus.why: 1NT is 15–17 balanced, and every balanced hand is opened 1NT – also with a five-card major. That is why ASS explores the whole major-suit holding.

bonus.correct: Mindst invit – ikke nødvendigvis en 4-farve i major
options: Mindst invit – ikke nødvendigvis en 4-farve i major
Altid en 4-farve i major, ingen pointkrav
bonus.why: ASS er mindst invitation til udgang og lover ikke nødvendigvis en 4-farve i major.

bonus.correct: At least invitational – not necessarily a four-card major
options: At least invitational – not necessarily a four-card major
Always a four-card major, no point requirement
bonus.why: ASS is at least a game invitation and does not necessarily promise a four-card major.
2♦ viser mindst én 4-farve i major. Svarer fortsætter krydsvendt: 2♥ = 4 spar, 2♠ = 4 hjerter.
2♦ shows at least one four-card major. Responder continues crosswise: 2♥ = 4 spades, 2♠ = 4 hearts.
